description: Header file defining ScalarType enum and related utility functions for tensor data types in PyTorch.

methods.name: elementSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of the data type represented by ScalarType.

methods.name: isIntegralType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is an integral type, optionally including bool.

methods.name: isFloat8Type
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is a float8 type.

methods.name: isReducedFloatingType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is a reduced floating point type.

methods.name: isFloatingType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is a floating point type.

methods.name: isComplexType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is a complex type.

methods.name: isBitsType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is a bits type.

methods.name: isBarebonesUnsignedType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is a barebones unsigned type.

methods.name: toQIntType
methods.description: Converts a ScalarType to its quantized integer type equivalent.

methods.name: isSignedType
methods.description: Checks if the ScalarType is signed.

methods.name: isUnderlying
methods.description: Checks if a type is the underlying type of a quantized type.

methods.name: toRealValueType
methods.description: Converts a complex ScalarType to its real value equivalent.

methods.name: toComplexType
methods.description: Converts a ScalarType to its complex equivalent.

methods.name: canCast
methods.description: Determines if one ScalarType can be cast to another according to casting rules.

methods.name: promoteTypes
methods.description: Returns the promoted ScalarType resulting from type promotion rules.

methods.name: getDtypeNames
methods.description: Returns the name and legacy name of a ScalarType.

methods.name: getStringToDtypeMap
methods.description: Returns a map from string names to ScalarType.
